verdict.rationale: Penpot documents an MCP server, a plugin API and access tokens, but no evidence shows an agent can render or export screenshots, images or production formats through them. The 'external rendering' line [penpot-docs-3] describes exposing objects and properties so other apps can render them, which is adjacent rather than export. The CSS/HTML/SVG/JSON line [penpot-docs-21] describes an inspect and code feature that is not tied to any programmatic surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can render and export designs — screenshots, images, or production formats — through a documented programmatic surface
